reason: Both sell cloud subscription software to small and mid-sized businesses. Paylocity is a focused HCM and payroll platform for employers. Intuit's core is small-business accounting (QuickBooks), consumer tax (TurboTax), personal finance (Credit Karma) and email marketing (Mailchimp). The overlap is on payroll and SMB customers. Intuit's main businesses sit outside Paylocity's scope and serve consumers too, so this is not a direct peer. The cited lines show Intuit's SMB finance software but do not directly show its payroll product.
